## Constants

<a name="PrivateDirectoryMode"></a>PrivateDirectoryMode and PrivateFileMode restrict new SafeRM data to its owner.

```go
const (
    PrivateDirectoryMode os.FileMode = 0o700
    PrivateFileMode      os.FileMode = 0o600
)
```

<a name="CheckTransfer"></a>
## func CheckTransfer

```go
func CheckTransfer(source, destination string, overwrite bool) (os.FileInfo, error)
```

CheckTransfer verifies that the source can be transferred to the destination and returns the source's file information. It returns ErrFileOverlap when the two paths are the same or one contains the other, and ErrFileExists when the destination is occupied and overwriting is not allowed.

<a name="Contains"></a>
## func Contains

```go
func Contains(directory, candidate string) bool
```

Contains reports whether the candidate path is the directory itself or lies anywhere beneath it. It compares the two paths without reading the filesystem.

<a name="Exists"></a>
## func Exists

```go
func Exists(path string) (bool, error)
```

Exists reports whether an item exists at the path. It does not follow a symbolic link in the final component, so a dangling link exists.

<a name="ExpandHome"></a>
## func ExpandHome

```go
func ExpandHome(path, home string) string
```

ExpandHome replaces a leading \~ with the home directory when the \~ stands alone or precedes a slash or backslash. It also converts the path's slashes to the operating system's separator.

<a name="Remove"></a>
## func Remove

```go
func Remove(ctx context.Context, path string) error
```

Remove permanently deletes the item at the path, including the contents of a directory. It deletes a symbolic link, not the link's target. It returns ErrFileMissing when nothing exists at the path.

<a name="Resolve"></a>
## func Resolve

```go
func Resolve(path, home string) (string, error)
```

Resolve returns the absolute form of a path, expanding a leading \~ to the home directory and resolving the symbolic links in its parent directories. A symbolic link in the final component stays unresolved, and trailing components that do not exist are kept as given. It returns ErrInputMissing for a blank path and ErrPathResolve when an existing parent is not a directory.

<a name="Transfer"></a>
## func Transfer

```go
func Transfer(ctx context.Context, source, destination string) error
```

Transfer moves an item from the source to an empty destination. It returns ErrFileExists when the destination is occupied and preserves both items.

Across filesystems, Transfer copies the item and removes the source only after the copy completes. A failed copy leaves the source intact and leaves the partial copy at the destination.

<a name="closeTransfer"></a>
## func closeTransfer

```go
func closeTransfer(file *os.File, resultErr *error)
```

closeTransfer closes the file and joins a failure to close it into the error that resultErr points to.

<a name="copyDirectory"></a>
## func copyDirectory

```go
func copyDirectory(ctx context.Context, source, destination string, mode os.FileMode) error
```

copyDirectory creates the destination directory, copies each child of the source into it through copyItem, and then gives the destination the supplied permissions.

<a name="copyFile"></a>
## func copyFile

```go
func copyFile(ctx context.Context, source, destination string, mode os.FileMode) (resultErr error)
```

copyFile copies the contents of the source file to a new destination file that has the supplied permissions, and syncs the destination to disk. Canceling the context stops the copy.

<a name="copyItem"></a>
## func copyItem

```go
func copyItem(ctx context.Context, source, destination string) error
```

copyItem copies a regular file, a directory with its contents, or a symbolic link to a destination that must not exist. It returns ErrFileUnsupported for any other kind of item.

<a name="crossDevice"></a>
## func crossDevice

```go
func crossDevice(err error) bool
```

crossDevice reports whether a rename failed because the source and the destination are on different filesystems.

<a name="renameExclusive"></a>
## func renameExclusive

```go
func renameExclusive(source, destination string) error
```

renameExclusive renames the source to the destination and fails when the destination already exists.

## type contextReader
